description_en: Queries scheduled vulnerability scan policies under the current Alibaba Cloud account by paging
description_zh: 分页查询当前阿里云账号下的漏洞定时扫描策略
name: ListVulScanScheduledStrategies

parameters.example: 研发部门每周漏洞扫描
parameters.help_en: The policy name. Fuzzy match is supported. The name can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 策略名称，支持模糊查询。长度不超过128个字符
parameters.name: strategy_name

parameters.help_en: The IDs of scheduled vulnerability scan policies used for filtering. A maximum of 100 IDs can be specified. Duplicate IDs are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 按漏洞定时扫描策略ID过滤，最多包含100个，不允许重复
parameters.name: strategy_ids

parameters.help_en:
Filters by enabled status. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
按启用状态过滤。取值：
Enabled：已启用。
Disabled：已停用
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
Filters by the matching mode of the effective scope. Valid values:
UserGroupAll: Takes effect for all users under the current Alibaba Cloud account.
UserGroupNormal: Takes effect only for users in specified user groups
parameters.help_zh:
按生效范围的匹配方式过滤。取值：
UserGroupAll：对当前阿里云账号下的全部用户生效。
UserGroupNormal：仅对指定用户组内的用户生效
parameters.name: match_mode

parameters.help_en:
The user group ID. Used to filter records whose effective scope includes the specified user group. You can obtain the value from the following operation:
[ListUserGroups](~~ListUserGroups~~): lists user groups
parameters.help_zh:
用户组ID，用于筛选生效范围包含该用户组的记录。取值来源：
[ListUserGroups](~~ListUserGroups~~)：批量查询用户组
parameters.name: user_group_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paging query. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paging query. Valid values: 1 to 1000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~1000
parameters.name: page_size

Strategies.description_en: The list of scheduled vulnerability scan policies
Strategies.description_zh: 漏洞定时扫描策略列表

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the policy was created, in seconds-level UNIX timestamp
CreateTime.description_zh: 策略创建时间，秒级Unix时间戳

CustomMatchGroup.description_en: The effective scope specified by organizational structure. An empty list is returned if the scope is not configured by organizational structure
CustomMatchGroup.description_zh: 按组织架构指定的生效范围。未按组织架构配置时返回空列表

Group.description_en: The collection of organizational structure nodes

items.description_en: The DN of the organizational structure node

LastTriggerTime.description_en: The time when the policy last triggered a scan, in seconds-level UNIX timestamp. The value 0 is returned if the policy has never been triggered
LastTriggerTime.description_zh: 策略最近一次触发扫描的时间，秒级Unix时间戳。从未触发过时返回0

MatchMode.description_en:
The matching mode of the effective scope. Valid values:
UserGroupAll: Takes effect for all users under the current Alibaba Cloud account.
UserGroupNormal: Takes effect only for users in specified user groups
MatchMode.description_zh:
生效范围的匹配方式。取值：
UserGroupAll：对当前阿里云账号下的全部用户生效。
UserGroupNormal：仅对指定用户组内的用户生效

MatchTargetIds.description_en: The collection of user group IDs that the policy takes effect for. An empty list is returned when MatchMode is set to UserGroupAll
MatchTargetIds.description_zh: 生效的用户组ID集合。MatchMode取值为UserGroupAll时返回空列表

Priority.description_en: The policy priority. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. Valid values: 1 to 100
Priority.description_zh: 策略优先级，数值越小优先级越高。取值范围：1~100

ScanBeginTime.description_en: The start hour during which scans can be triggered. The value is an integer representing the hour of the day. Valid values: 0 to 23 (inclusive). This field is not a timestamp
ScanBeginTime.description_zh: 允许触发扫描的起始小时，取整点小时数，取值范围：0~23，包含该小时。本字段不是时间戳

ScanEndTime.description_en: The end hour during which scans can be triggered. The value is an integer representing the hour of the day. Valid values: 1 to 24 (exclusive). The value must be greater than ScanBeginTime. This field is not a timestamp
ScanEndTime.description_zh: 允许触发扫描的结束小时，取整点小时数，取值范围：1~24，不包含该小时，且必须大于ScanBeginTime。本字段不是时间戳

ScanFrequency.description_en:
The unit of the trigger cycle. Valid values:
day: by day.
week: by week
ScanFrequency.description_zh:
触发周期的单位。取值：
day：按天。
week：按周

ScanInterval.description_en: The interval number of the trigger cycle. This parameter works together with ScanFrequency to determine the trigger cycle. Valid values: 1 to 30. For example, if ScanFrequency is set to week and ScanInterval is set to 1, the scan is triggered once a week
ScanInterval.description_zh: 触发周期的间隔数，与ScanFrequency共同决定触发周期。取值范围：1~30。例如ScanFrequency取值为week、ScanInterval取值为1时，表示每周扫描一次

Status.description_en:
The enabled status. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
Status.description_zh:
启用状态。取值：
Enabled：已启用。
Disabled：已停用

StrategyDescription.example: 每周日凌晨对研发部门终端执行漏洞扫描

StrategyId.description_en: The ID of the scheduled vulnerability scan policy

StrategyName.example: 研发部门每周漏洞扫描

Whitelist.description_en: The list of exempt usernames. Users in this list are excluded from the scan of this policy. An empty list is returned if no exemptions are configured
Whitelist.description_zh: 例外用户名单，名单内的用户不执行该策略的扫描。未配置时返回空列表

TotalNum.description_en: The total number of scheduled vulnerability scan policies that match the query conditions
TotalNum.description_zh: 符合查询条件的漏洞定时扫描策略总数
